app.name: Sona
app.tagline: Speak a sentence, land a line

voice.idle: Press once to start, once more to stop
voice.failed: Not inserted; the text is kept on this page
voice.noSpeech: No speech detected — nothing was written.
voice.maxTake: Ten-minute limit reached — this take was written out.
voice.idleHold: Hold the hotkey, speak, and release

dashboard.title: Hold to speak, release to land
dashboard.titleTap: Press once to speak, once to land
dashboard.hint: Hotkey {{hotkey}}, or use the button below. Esc cancels.
dashboard.hintHold: Hold {{hotkey}} to speak and release to land; the button below taps to start. Esc cancels.
dashboard.noResult: Nothing dictated yet. Try one sentence.
dashboard.emptyRecent: Your first dictation will show up here.
dashboard.hintTouch: Tap the button below to start, and tap again to stop.

setup.title: One step left
setup.subtitle: Recognition or polish is not ready yet. Finish setup to start dictating anywhere.
setup.welcomeBody: Speak a sentence, and it lands at the caret. One minute of setup, then a single key is all you need.
setup.privacyAudio: Audio exists only between key-down and key-up; it is never written to disk.
setup.privacyHold: Hold the hotkey to speak by default; release to finish. You can switch to tap-to-start in Settings.
setup.privacyContext: Caret context is capped at 300 characters and can be turned off.
setup.privacyKeys: Keys prefer the system keychain. Sona has no relay server.
setup.asrHint: Speech becomes text first. SiliconFlow or DashScope work well in China; Groq is fast if you can reach it.
setup.localHint: Run an OpenAI-compatible Whisper server on this machine. Audio never leaves it.
setup.polishHint: Polish removes filler words and adds punctuation. If it fails, the raw transcript is still written.
setup.polishOffHint: Write the transcript directly, without a second model.
setup.hotkeyHint: Press this combination in any app, speak, press again, and the text lands at the caret.
setup.hotkeyHintHold: Hold this combination in any app, speak, and release; the text lands at the caret.
setup.hotkeyFailed: That combination is taken by the system. Try another.
setup.trialHint: Put the caret in the box below and press {{hotkey}} to speak.
setup.trialHintHold: Put the caret in the box below, hold {{hotkey}}, speak, and release to finish.
setup.trialPlaceholder: Try here, e.g. “Review meeting next Monday at ten.”
setup.trialWaiting: Press {{hotkey}} now, then press it again when you finish.
setup.trialWaitingHold: Hold {{hotkey}} now, then release when you finish.
setup.trialDone: Got it — the text landed in the box.
setup.trialSkip: Nothing happened? Check microphone permission, or skip for now.
setup.testFirst: Test the connection first to make sure the URL and key are right.
setup.notReady: Almost there: fill in the URL, model and key, or switch to a local server.
setup.doneBody: Press {{hotkey}} whenever you want to dictate. You can rerun this guide from Settings.
setup.finished: Setup complete. Press your hotkey to dictate.
setup.browserTrial: Recording is unavailable in the browser preview; the desktop app runs this step with the real microphone.
setup.macPermission: macOS asks for Accessibility on the first paste. If no prompt appears, enable Sona in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.

mode.lightHint: Drop filler, repetitions and self-corrections; keep the meaning.
mode.structuredHint: Reshape into a prompt an AI can act on, keeping every constraint.

insert.pasteHint: Writes to the clipboard and sends a synthetic paste; falls back to copy.

history.title: Dictations
history.subtitle: {{count}} entries on this device; the latest 500 are kept.
history.emptyHint: Raw transcript and polished text both land here after your first run.
history.clearDescription: Every dictation will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
history.learnTitle: Add this fix to the dictionary
history.learnHint: The same mis-recognition will be rewritten next time, and the word joins the glossary sent to the polish model.
history.deleteDescription:
The original and polished text will be deleted permanently:
“{{preview}}”

dictionary.title: Vocabulary
dictionary.subtitle: Add the names the recogniser keeps missing: transcripts are rewritten first, and the list is also sent as a glossary to the polish model.
dictionary.emptyHint: Product names, people and commands make recognition far steadier.
dictionary.aliasesHint: Comma separated, e.g. cloud, claud. Longest match wins.
dictionary.formHint: Aliases match case-insensitively as whole words; Chinese matches literally.

providers.title: Recognition and polish
providers.subtitle: No relay server: requests go straight from this device to the endpoint you enter. Keys stay on this device.
providers.asrDescription: Turns audio into text. Needs an OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions.
providers.polishDescription: Turns speech into written text. Needs an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions.
providers.privacyAudio: Audio is sent only to the recogniser you chose, for that one request, and is never written to disk.
providers.privacyContext: Caret context is capped at 300 characters; set it to 0 to disable.
providers.privacyStorage: History and dictionary stay in this device's app data directory; API keys prefer the system keychain and normally never reach settings.json.
providers.localHint: Turn on when Whisper runs on this machine (faster-whisper-server, whisper.cpp server…): same API, no key, audio never leaves the computer.
providers.localTestHint: Listing only reads /models; Test checks the endpoint on screen and never uploads audio.
providers.keyOptional: Optional for local or self-hosted servers
providers.keychainFallback: System keychain unavailable: keys are kept in settings.json (owner-readable only). Save the provider again after fixing the keychain to migrate them.
providers.testNeedsConfig: Fill in the URL, model and key before testing.
providers.testAsrHint: Only reads /models; no audio is uploaded.
providers.testPolishHint: Sends one minimal request; no dictation text.
providers.testBrowserBlocked: The browser preview cannot reach providers directly (usually CORS). Test in the desktop app.
providers.deskBody: One key for multiple transcription and cleanup models. Keys, models, and usage live at desk.binrc.com.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences are persisted on this device by the Rust backend.
settings.contextHint: Reads text around the caret to infer tone and terminology. 0 disables it.
settings.holdToTalkHint: Press to start and release to finish. Turn off to tap once to start and again to stop.
settings.hotkeyHint: Use forms like Alt+Space, CmdOrControl+Shift+D, F9. Cancel stays in-app and never steals a system key.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.languageHint: Untouched built-in packs follow the interface language.

settings.autoStopHint: Finish by itself when you stop talking; ten seconds of silence drops the take.
settings.customInstructionHint: Appended to the prompt. It shapes tone, length and format; it never overrides the format-only rules.
settings.customInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. First person, short sentences, no corporate tone.
settings.soundHint: Two quiet blips so you know the microphone opened and closed.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Writes a JSON bundle with no keys and no dictation text.
settings.rerunSetupHint: Walk through recognition, polish and the hotkey again. History and dictionary are untouched.
settings.autostartHint: Start in the menu bar after you sign in; the hotkey works without opening the main window.
settings.autostartFailed: Could not change the login item. Check your system settings and try again.
settings.resetDescription: Appearance, dictation, shortcut and style pack settings will return to their initial state. History, dictionary entries and API keys in the system keychain are not deleted. This cannot be undone.

capsule.hint: Press {{hotkey}} to start · Esc to close
capsule.holdHint: Hold {{hotkey}} to talk · release to finish
capsule.retryHint: Tap the mic to retry, Esc to close

error.asrNotConfigured: No speech recognition provider is configured.
error.polishNotConfigured: No text polish provider is configured.
error.badKey: The key was rejected — check the API key.
error.microphoneDenied: macOS blocked the microphone. Allow Sona in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then reopen the app.
error.microphoneMissing: No microphone was found. Connect one or choose an input in System Settings → Sound.
error.microphoneBusy: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
error.unreachable: Cannot reach the service — check the URL, network or proxy.
error.endpoint: Wrong endpoint: the service does not expose that path.
error.noModels: The service listed no models. Make sure it has loaded one.

selection.hint: Select text, then press {{hotkey}}; the rewrite replaces the selection.

snippets.subtitle: Say a short phrase, land a whole block. Snippets are expanded after polishing, so the model cannot rewrite them.
snippets.emptyHint: Say “weekly template” and land a ready-made outline.
snippets.triggerHint: ASCII phrases match whole words, case-insensitively; CJK matches literally. Longer phrases win.
snippets.expansionPlaceholder: e.g. hi@example.com, or a multi-line template
snippets.expansionHint: Line breaks are kept. This text is inserted verbatim, without polishing.
snippets.triggerRequired: The spoken phrase cannot be empty.
snippets.expansionRequired: The inserted text cannot be empty.
snippets.sameText: The phrase and the inserted text cannot be identical.
snippets.triggerTooLong: That phrase is too long — keep it under 80 characters.
snippets.expansionTooLong: That block is too long — keep it under 4000 characters.
snippets.formHint: When you say this phrase, Sona replaces it with the text below.

pending.title: The last take did not make it
pending.hint: The {{seconds}}s recording is still in memory. Retry directly; it is dropped when the app quits.

packs.title: Style packs
packs.subtitle: Save a polish mode and an extra instruction under one name. Switch voices for meetings, email and notes without opening settings.
packs.none: No style pack applied yet. Pick one below, or save your current setup.
packs.adjustedHint: You changed the mode or instruction by hand. Reapply to restore this pack.
packs.importEmpty: No style packs found on the clipboard.
packs.importFailed: Could not read the clipboard. Paste the exported JSON.
packs.exportEmpty: No custom packs to export yet.
packs.formHint: Pick a polish mode, then add one instruction it should follow.
packs.name: Name
packs.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. Keep action items and owners. Do not add anything that was not said.
packs.instructionHint: Only affects polish; up to 600 characters. Leave empty to use the mode alone.
packs.rawHint: Verbatim skips the polish model, so an instruction has no effect here.
packs.limit: You can keep up to 24 custom packs
packs.notFound: That style pack no longer exists
packs.importDuplicate: These packs already exist; nothing was imported.
packs.clipboardUnavailable: Could not read the clipboard. Check system permissions.
packs.discardHint: Your edits will not be saved after closing.
packs.discardBody: Changes to the name, polish mode and instruction will be lost.
packs.cycleNeedOne: Keep at least one pack in the cycle
packs.cycleEmpty: No packs are in the hotkey cycle. Check at least one on the Style page.
